posts.body_html:
Anyone who has dealt with Mike already knows what a great source of information and experience he is.  I have talked to Mike several times over the years, asking tons of questions about breeding, seedling selection, his thoughts on genetics and recessive traits.  Mike has always been quick to respond and gave his honest open thoughts on each subject, never got the impression he was trying to "keep secrets" about anything.

My first order with Mike was a few years ago, probably 4-5 years back now.  After some time away from Sarracenia, I decided to get my collection going again, and once again I contacted Mike.  As everyone knows, the plants showed up in amazing shape, they are stunning examples of what I asked for, always blown away by his plants and service to this hobby.

Thanks again Mike!

-Opha

posts.body_html: Mike is the best. I will have to post some pics at some point but my last order from Mike went awry with USPS. My box was lost for two weeks and when the plants arrived... well... lets just say that no good deed goes unpunished. The USPS ate something that Mike felt bad about letting go. I did my best to save it but sometimes the USPS demands a plant sacrifice. Mike sent replacement plants when I told him not to. I was able to save everything that I had purchased but Mike insisted on sending replacements. I still feel terrible about killing something that Mike thought was special, though.

posts.body_html: If you want sarracenia, his customer service is great because he really cares about growing the best plants and giving his customers only the best. The plants I have bought from Mike are vigorous and ready to grow!  I have bought plants from him in mid summer when it is normally risky in my climate to start plants bare root and they have out performed my other established plants. I would say some of them are ahead of others by a year or two in terms of establishment!  I think that the care and excellence that Mike strives for shows in his product.  I only buy Sarracenia from Mike Wang. The genetics are unsurpassed not only in display but in vigor.

posts.body_html: As a former dealer in carnivorous plants for many years (Cascade Carnivorous Plants, 1990-2005) and as a long time collector and grower, I have experience in recognizing really well grown plants and superb customer service stemming from experience and in-depth knowledge of the plants themselves. I have dealt with Mike occasionally for years now, and my most recent purchase continues to show me that, while there are many people out there who grow carnivorous plants and many who sell them, there are very few people who have both the long-term experience and give the consistently great service that Mike provides. He is always generous to a fault with his knowledge and his plants, and this puts him in with the best grower/dealers out there. You may find them cheaper elsewhere occasionally, but you won't find many people like Mike out there, and his plants are always superb. It has been, as always, a pleasure doing business with you Mike.
